final_message:
I implemented `PathMatcher` in `src/matcher.ts`. All 3 tests pass with `npm test`.

Each pattern compiles once to an anchored regex. `*`, `?`, and `**` follow the README rules, and other characters match literally. `!` patterns are checked last-to-first, so the last matching pattern decides. I also checked the README edge cases, including `src/**` not matching `src`, `a**b` not crossing `/`, and `explain` returning the pattern with its `!`.

I first wrote the file with a stray `create` that failed because the stub existed. I deleted the stub and recreated it. Only `src/matcher.ts` changed.
